content_text: Is there really any differences between lighting things with tungsten than LED? I’ve been said that tungsten is better for lighting skin, but is it truly a great advantage over LED? Also tungsten could get very hot in some interiors. Probably I will sound ignorant, but wouldn’t it be better to always use LED? Due to it’s practicallity
